name: FNCE 4303
title: Advanced Issues in Asset Allocation and Portfolio Management
description: Valuation of a business including models such as discounted cash flows, relative metrics, contingent claim valuation and liquidation value; evaluation of specific business models that companies pursue to create competitive advantage including toll gate positioning, segregation vs. integration, and organic vs. mechanistic strategies.
requirement_description: FNCE 3101; FNCE 3302 or 3303; open only to Business majors of junior or higher status.
